kernel_semantics_mirrored.pattern: 0xA5 (STACK_WATERMARK_PATTERN); test_pattern_constant_matches_kernel_source asserts it against the source text

api.guest_view.GuestView(cr3, read_physical,: one per pause point (caches page-table pages). translate(va)->(pa|None, witness); page_info(va)->{va,present,pa,leaf_shift,leaf_pte,flags}; read(va,n) page-by-page, raises GuestUnmappedError on absent page. Errors: GuestReadError (read failed / wrong-sized reply / unreadable table), GuestUnmappedError(va); both GuestMemoryError.
api.stack_watermark.measure(view, start, top: -> dict: usable_start, top, usable_bytes, untouched_prefix_bytes, depth_bytes, depth_pages, status (untouched|partial|saturated-proven|saturated-unproven), exact (== primed_proof given), depth_valid (False only for saturated-unproven), prime_evidence (pre-run-verified|in-band-prefix|none), sp_depth_bytes/watermark_covers_sp if sp. Raises StackRangeError (misaligned/empty/inverted/>2^64 range, sp outside [start,top], proof not for this range/pattern), GuestUnmappedError (ANY usable page absent, checked for all pages even though the scan stops at the first non-pattern byte), GuestReadError.
api.stack_watermark.verify_primed(view, star: pre-run proof that [start,limit) is entirely pattern; raises PrimeVerificationError(va, got) on the first differing byte. Take it while the stack has not run yet and pass as primed_proof.
api.stack_watermark.leading_pattern_run(data: pure mirror of the kernel scan loop.
api.resident.Region(label, kind in {elf-segm: labelled range; page span rounds start down / end up exactly as observer._snapshot does.
api.resident.count_regions(view, regions, *,: -> {scope, regions:[{label,kind,va,size_bytes,page_span,pages,present_pages,not_present_pages,mapped_backed_bytes,not_present_bytes,fully_mapped,distinct_frames,not_present_ranges,leaf_page_sizes,overlaps,extra}], total:{sum_of_region_mapped_backed_bytes, distinct_frame_bytes, distinct_frame_bytes_excluding_heap_arena, not_present_pages}}. Absent pages are flagged (not an error); unreadable tables raise GuestReadError. No key or field is named rss.
api.memory_snapshot.regions_from_observer_in: converts the observer instance dict + elf_layout() loads into Regions: elf-load-N = base+s.va/memsz; user-stack = stack_bottom..stack_top; kernel_stack=(va,size) and heap_arena=(va,size) are CALLER-supplied (the observer does not know them).
api.memory_snapshot.collect(view, regions, *: -> JSON record {schema cellos.s10-7.memory-snapshot/1, phase, instance, cr3, monotonic_ns, provenance, resident, stacks[], stack_depth_bytes{user,kernel}, heap_arena, errors[], ok, all_stack_depths_exact, limits[]}. provenance must carry kernel_build, profile and kernel_features containing 'test-hooks' (ValueError otherwise). Per-region failures are retained in errors[] and force ok=false; the caller must STOP on ok=false. stack_sp/primed_proofs are dicts keyed by region label.

limits: Guest-resident figures under QEMU/TCG of one paused vCPU; not host RSS, working set, physical memory or Intel/VMX figures.

mapped_backed_bytes = guest-present 4 KiB pages under the eager SAS identity mapping; resident-by-construction from source reading (no demand-paging/swap path found), NOT an accessed/dirty measurement. Source-derived claim; the S10-7.0 known-answer check (page counts vs allocator/stack sizes) is still the 7.4 acceptance task.

Stack sentinel depth valid only on the separately built labelled test-hooks measurement kernel, never the promoted candidate kernel; depth is a LOWER BOUND (zero-valued/pattern-equal 0xA5 stores invisible; a stray non-pattern byte below the real deepest store inflates it).
exact=true requires a pre-run verify_primed proof; a fully consumed range with no proof is indistinguishable from an unprimed stack and is reported saturated-unproven / depth_valid=false.
Peaks are since priming at spawn; snapshot is point-in-time. Kernel stack depth includes the spawn trap frame at its top.
Heap arena is reported separately and may sit inside ELF .bss (overlap listed; use distinct_frame_bytes[_excluding_heap_arena]).

Synthetic fixtures prove the algorithms, not that a real QEMU gdbstub physical read returns identical bytes; that stays an unrun live-path assumption (retained RspClient.read_physical_memory is used by the existing observer already).
open_inputs_for_7_4: Kernel-stack usable range (va,size) is NOT known to the observer. [INFERENCE, unverified] candidates: TSS.rsp0 / CPU_LOCAL.kernel_rsp (set_kernel_stack, task.rs:1655-1750) via host-readable TSS (needs TR/GDT, which the retained gdb register set may not expose) or the HMP 'info registers'; the test-hooks `[stack-baseline]` serial line gives only used_bytes/usable_bytes/alloc_bytes, no address, but its used_bytes is directly comparable to depth_bytes as a cross-check (identical semantics).
Heap-arena (va,size) is not recorded by observer; only Heap.used counter at base+0x8a80c0 is. Arena would come from the ELF symbol table (6 MiB reservation per S10-7.0).
Pre-run priming proof needs a stop before the task runs: the existing Cellbox entry stop (observer.py _entry, cs&3==3) is the user-stack point; verify_primed(view, stack_bottom, initial_rsp & ~4095).

wiring_point_S10_7_4.snapshot_hook: observer.Observer._snapshot(self, name)  — observer.py line 123; called on the observer thread at an all-stop via Observer._pending() (line 133) when Surface.snapshot(name) (common.py:121) -> Observer.snapshot(name) (line 141) queues a request. In the Hook runs it is reached through HookObserver._snapshot(self, name) (observer-feed-hook/hook_observer.py:185), which special-cases the DISARM name and otherwise calls super()._snapshot(name) (CoordinatedObserver does not override it).
wiring_point_S10_7_4.already_known_in_that_function: inst = self.instances[self.focus]; cr3 = inst['cr3']; ELF ranges inst['base'] + s['va'], s['memsz'] for s in self.loads (from elf_layout(), keys va/memsz/filesz/offset/flags); user stack pages inst['stack_pages'] (va->pa; inst['stack_bottom'], inst['stack_top'], 64 KiB, two guard pages below verified unmapped at entry); inst['initial_rsp']; allocator counter value read from inst['heap'] (the 'aligned_live_used_bytes' already in the snapshot). Reader: self.client.read_physical_memory(addr, length) (rsp.py:321), same one passed to walk_page there.
wiring_point_S10_7_4.call_there: view = GuestView(cr3, self.client.read_physical_memory); regions = regions_from_observer_instance(inst, self.loads, kernel_stack=<TBD>, heap_arena=<TBD>, heap_used_bytes=value); rec = collect(view, regions, phase=name, instance=inst['id'], provenance=<test-hooks kernel label>, primed_proofs=<from entry>); dump rec next to mapping-NN-<name>.json; need(rec['ok'], ...).
wiring_point_S10_7_4.entry_hook_for_priming_proof: observer.Observer._entry(self, pc) — observer.py line 58 — after cr3/sp are read and the user stack pages verified: store verify_primed(GuestView(cr3, self.client.read_physical_memory), inst['stack_bottom'], inst['initial_rsp'] & ~4095) in inst before any user instruction runs.
